findings.description: AWS access key and secret access key are embedded in plaintext in the EC2 user_data script, which is stored unencrypted in instance metadata and Terraform state, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with instance or state access.
The security group allows inbound TCP port 22 (SSH) from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing administrative access to the entire internet.

The security group allows inbound TCP port 80 from 0.0.0.0/0. While this may be intentional for a public web server, combined with the instance also being placed in a public subnet with a public IP, this expands the internet-facing attack surface with no compensating controls such as a load balancer or WAF.
The EBS volume does not have the encrypted attribute enabled (explicitly commented out), leaving data at rest unencrypted and recoverable if the underlying storage is compromised.
The snapshot is taken from an unencrypted EBS volume and has no encryption configured, so sensitive data captured in the snapshot remains unencrypted and could be shared or exposed insecurely.

map_public_ip_on_launch is set to true, automatically assigning public IPs to instances launched in this subnet; combined with the open security group this directly increases exposure of the web host to the internet.

map_public_ip_on_launch is set to true, automatically assigning public IPs to instances launched in this subnet, increasing exposure to the public internet even though no instance currently uses this subnet.

findings.issue_category: missing encryption and public access controls
findings.description: The S3 bucket used for VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration and no public access block or bucket policy restricting access, risking exposure or tampering of network log data.

force_destroy = true allows the bucket containing flow logs to be deleted along with all its contents without additional protection, which could be leveraged to destroy audit/log evidence; this is a data-integrity/security-relevant control for a logging bucket rather than a purely operational setting.
